g.text: Same 1,800 noisy observations: 15 gains and one loss versus donor masking.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Both frozen targets pass: ≥245 exact recoveries and ≤4 paired regressions.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: All 256 fresh banks retained; every degree inferred correctly from the first 600 noisy rows.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Three pooled graphs remain wrong: banks 105, 168 and 197. Bank 105 is the single paired loss.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Donor alone also recovers the same 239 banks; masking adds no exact recoveries.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: Synthetic graph recovery, not puzzle accuracy. BP uses a fixed training budget; compute is not matched.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #444444

g.text: A separately reviewed audit fixes only a NumPy-version assertion; the original incomplete run is retained.

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Exact replay: 11,008 LP certificates, 33,024 rejected proof mutations, and all 256 regenerated source banks.
